body:
Pass 5. $C5 fix confirmed. relation_fit validated against base R and I found no defects - residual_df exact, effect_covariance matches C(Xw'Xw)^-1C' to 1.4e-17 under an AR whitener, residual_block matches qr.resid to 1.4e-15 with correct orthogonality, capability refusal exact on all three accessors, rank-deficient design refused informatively. Good work; this was my highest-priority item from the original review.

One forward-looking item, $C6 (p2), filed now because it shapes Epic 5's accumulator: residual_block is not block-plan invariant (0.5-4 ULP across block sizes). Harmless alone, but Epic 5 accumulates in bounded blocks then inverts, so the memory budget perturbs the metric - measured 1.99e-16 in Sigma becoming 1.74e-12 in K at cond=1.68e5. At the cond>=1e8 typical of unshrunk local covariance that approaches expect_equal's default tolerance. You already have .canonical_reduce; either use it for residual accumulation or declare block-plan dependence and record the plan in the recipe signature. Blocker note on Epic 5.

$C1 (p0) and $C2 are still the only unaddressed items and both gate Epic 2.
